<function name="GetTransposed" parent="VMatrix" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the transpose (each row becomes a column) of this matrix.
	</description>
	<added>2021.12.15</added>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="transposed" type="VMatrix">The transposed matrix.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
